scope: saved outputs, original RGB and historical human semantic labels only

label_contract.human_target: Existing reference-corner semantic visibility, not occupancy segmentation of a pixel.
label_contract.v61_target: Final visible target M4 occupancy at nearest initial-query pixel.
label_contract.near_distance: Distance to existing human reference location; <=3px does not certify which physical instance owns the nearest pixel.
label_contract.real_pixel_reference: No verified real target-instance pixel mask exists in these sources; exact-pixel transfer accuracy and mismatch fraction are unidentifiable.
label_contract.source_provenance: Visibility sidecar uses old frozen coordinates and does not create a new independent 6D or subpixel reference.
review_rules: Judge frame severity from the original RGB before opening the reference overlay.
The overlay contains reference identities only; it contains no Base/N3 prediction or error.
Opening the overlay is recorded as reference exposure.
Do not infer visibility from coordinate presence, PnP projection, or validity flags.
Existing 71 statuses remain provenance-locked; a new opinion must be a separate review revision.
Missing-reference slots may be annotated, but do not enter the existing 2D denominator.

architecture_evidence.input: Frozen YOLO P3 64 channels plus valid channel, bilinear sampled to 9x9.
architecture_evidence.head: two Conv3x3/GELU, global average pooling, linear scalar; no raw RGB central-pixel branch
architecture_evidence.interpretation: Nominal P3 stride and context pooling make <=3 raw pixels sub-feature-scale. This is a capability concern, not a proved failure cause.

visual_review: 16 examples directly inspected via view_image; 12 deterministic strata and 4 low-error supplements. See VISUAL_REVIEW.csv. Diagnostic comments are not pixel GT.
